acceptance: separately report model improvement and full observed controller/training/audit cost; no native benefit or multi-generation capability claim without actual evidence
candidate_space: all quota-legal resident masks at every step, with the same epochs and cost model; approximate policies may prune search states and say so
cost_boundary: declared workload model costs and measured host wall are distinct; every losing training candidate, generation selection, oracle audit and reporting overhead is retained; model validation, witness replay, build and native ranking are wall costs outside the search-transition unit
evolution: three rounds of local parameter mutation; train-only proposal, fresh selection split for each generation, strict modeled no-regression gate
fixed_control: fixed empty resident set, same resource arithmetic
learned_control: empirical risk minimization over the frozen linear retention-feature grid on training tasks only

module_input.build_cost: all native-study build/preparation cost retained separately; binaries already built for forecast
module_input.memory: artifact bytes are a declared accounting proxy, not measured RSS bound
module_input.pairing: HIA incumbent paired with each of seven registered alternatives, no value-based arm selection
module_input.retirement_cost: 0 is an explicit modeling assumption; not a measured unload cost
module_input.scope: timing-sample split on the same semantic corpus, not independent unseen semantic tasks
module_input.split: group0 training; group1 sample windows0:12,12:24,24:36 fresh generation selection; groups2/3 final

native_ablation: frozen policy supplies <=4 complete candidates to source-pinned native supplied/supplied_ndu modes; same candidate set, no DP/search in either native mode; absence remains blocked
oracle_budget_scope: exact is an independent diagnostic oracle control with separately retained search/wall cost, not an equal-budget controller
scope: finite declared dynamic-cache models, optionally driven by complete stb_divide native-study measurements; no new native workload delivery claim
transition_budget_scope: one shared allowance per controller; every considered search action is charged as executed across all training candidates, every generation incumbent/candidate selection, and final search; failed work remains charged
